title: seat.create input
description: Translate Colin's requested kind of work into a helper declaration. Read the published seats and projects with registry_read before asking for information already declared. Choose implementation details yourself from those declarations; ask Colin only about genuinely missing purpose or project scope, not schema fields.

seat.description: Use the requested name, or derive a short name from the requested work. Check existing seats first; reuse an appropriate existing helper rather than creating a duplicate.

purpose.description: Describe the work Colin requested in plain language; derive this from his request and the conversation, not a separate configuration question.

template.description: Read published worker seats and choose the closest enabled builder or judge for the requested work. This is the coordinator's implementation choice, not a field Colin must supply; never copy a conversation seat or widen the template's authority.

projects.description: Resolve the projects named in the request, established in the conversation, or supplied by an explicit declared default against published project IDs. Do not treat a list of allowed projects as a default. Ask about intended work scope only when those sources do not resolve it.
